# `start_scan_planet`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Launch the sun/moon scan worker.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcb6f0, StartScanSun @0x2efae0, CheckRelayReq2Slave @0xae1e0 (64-bit build); firmware 9.75 call site @0xd97e4, CheckRelayReq2Slave @0xbc980 (arguments relay false, type 1) |

No parameters are read, and the handler does not parse a planet name despite the method name. After the relay check the handler clears a scan flag and starts the named scan worker; it does not wait for the scan to finish. A success reply means the worker was launched. Which scan the worker performs, and the event it reports through, are not established from the starter.

Side effects: Runs the relay check (occupy type 1; in firmware 9.75 it is called with relaying disabled, so it only tests occupancy and always continues locally; in firmware 9.31 the call form was not diffed), clears a scan flag and launches the scan worker thread.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 524 | the Sun-scan starter: function state is not 1 or view mode is not one of 2, 3, 4 | `function conflict` |
| 203 | Relay check: the local or second-camera mount is occupied | `equipment is moving` |
| 212 | Worker thread could not be created or has no thread function | `fail to create thread` |
| 300 | Relay forwarding helper has a null context | `internal error` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

In the wide-route case the original request is relayed and the forwarded reply is returned in place of the local one; the second device's replies, errors and latency (the relay waits up to 10000 ms) are unresolved, as is the worker-start error set below 212. Event name and payload of the scan worker are unresolved (no direct emitter in the starter).

## Example

Request, start:

```json
{"id":101,"method":"start_scan_planet"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_scan_planet","result":0,"code":0,"id":101}
```

Reply, wrong-mode:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_scan_planet","error":"function conflict","code":524,"id":102}
```
